question: The carcinogenic action of Benzo (a) pyrene:

options.opa: It is due to the production of oxygen free radicals.
options.opb: It is due to its biotransformation in a dihydrodiol.
options.opc: It is due to its biotransformation in an epoxide.
options.opd: It increases in tissues rich in epoxide hydrolase.
options.ope: It diminishes in tissues rich in cytochrome P450.
